verdict.rationale: Mangopay documents local-currency payouts: it sends funds 'locally and internationally in 24+ currencies' and routes over the domestic rail when the currency and country match. That covers only the settlement slice of the story, and only as a count rather than a published list or map. Missing for 10: a documented list or map of supported seller-onboarding countries, a per-country catalogue of local payment methods, an explicit per-country currency settlement table, and independent corroboration.

support.subject: As a founder, sellers can join from where they are — supported onboarding countries, local payment methods, and local-currency settlement documented as a coverage map, not discovered ticket by ticket

citations.quote: Send funds locally and internationally in 24+ currencies
